text:
Maria G.: Ok team — starting the cloud account + VNet scaffold for eu-central-3 (new region bring-up). Goal: provision project, VPC, subnets for prod/staging/dev, request GPU quota, and hand off to SRE for cluster validation. I pasted a short runbook below, please review quickly and flag blockers.

InfraBot: Created ticket INFRA-4921 for GPU quota requests and INFRA-4922 for project creation. https://redwood.atlassian.io/browse/INFRA-4921 :robot_face:

Kevin L.: For CIDR thinking: avoid 10.0.0.0/8 because partner overlaps. Propose using 10.128.0.0/16 for region VPC, split as: prod 10.128.0.0/18, staging 10.128.64.0/18, dev 10.128.128.0/19. Keeps room for future. Also please confirm route table limits on the provider — we might need fewer peerings.

Anika R.: +1 on the split. Note provider route limit: 1000 routes per VPC — fine for us but watch transit gateway attachments. Also we should reserve a /24 for shared-services (10.128.192.0/24) for KMS, model-registry endpoints, and bastion. For KMS/PrivateLink we'll need endpoints in that subnet.

Maria G.: here's the minimal Terraform snippet I'm planning to land to scaffold the VPC (staging first):

```hcl
resource "aws_vpc" "eu3" {
  cidr_block = "10.128.0.0/16"
  enable_dns_hostnames = true
  tags = { Name = "redwood-eu3-vpc" }
}

resource "aws_subnet" "prod" {
  vpc_id = aws_vpc.eu3.id
  cidr_block = "10.128.0.0/18"
  availability_zone = "eu-central-1a"
  tags = { Name = "prod-subnet-eu3-a" }
}

# NAT/GW and route tables handled by module x.network-nat (autoscale via managed provider NAT gateway)
```

Kevin L.: A couple notes: 1) Add tags for billing/project code 2) Ensure subnets are created across AZs for GPU nodes — we need at least 2 AZs with capacity. 3) For H100/A100 quotas cloud asked for workload justification — please add the expected baseline: 8x A100 for canary, 32x for initial prod fleet.

SRE Lead: Firewall and k8s requirements: open kubelet 10250 between nodes and control plane; allow node-exporter/metrics 9100; restrict SSH by default (we use session-manager), open egress to S3/model-registry (443) and model-pull registries. Also add health-check endpoints from LB.

Anika R.: Cost ops: recommend enabling flow logs to a central bucket for 30 days, estimate egress NAT costs — put a conservative initial estimate in FinOps sheet (link pasted in ticket). Also enable resource tags so FinOps script picks them up.

Maria G.: Smoke test commands for after cluster bring-up (run in staging):

```bash
# create a tiny pod on GPU node pool
kubectl run gpu-smoke --image=nvcr.io/nvidia/cuda:11.7-runtime -it --requests='nvidia.com/gpu=1' --restart=Never -- bash -c "nvidia-smi && sleep 30"

# curl internal model-registry
curl -v https://model-registry.internal/health || true
```

Kevin L.: I'll start the GPU quota request template. Draft justification: "bench + canary + failover capacity for inference serving in eu-central-3; expected sustained 24/7 usage for core endpoints; initial request 40 A100 equivalents with scale plan to 120 within 6 months." Please review.

SRE Lead: Handoff checklist (short):
- quotas approved and limits visible in console
- terraform apply in staging with drift check
- cross-account peering to shared-services validated (routes + SGs)
- smoke tests pass (pod + registry + S3 access)
- cost estimate reviewed and FinOps tagged
- oncall rotation & runbook updated

InfraBot: terraform apply finished in staging at 1759990025 by pipeline #deploy-ops-eu3. Plan: promote to prod after manual signoff.

Maria G.: Thanks — if no major objections I'll file the sign-off request and start the prod apply tomorrow. :thumbsup:
